subject: Discovery follow-up: Schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-13T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: Schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Thanks again for taking the time today, Sam — I really appreciated the overview of FinPath's use case and the performance/cost constraints you're balancing. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (high level):
- Goals: Use LLM inference for personalized financial advice snippets and account summarization across 10M monthly active users.
- Key constraints: 99th pct latency target 350ms, strict PII handling, on-prem/private deployment discussions for regulated flows.
- Current blockers: security questionnaire (SOC 2 details), procurement timeline, and a technical review of model/latency tradeoffs.

Proposed next step: Technical deep-dive / demo (we'll show dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs, KV caching benefits, and a preliminary cost estimate). Please confirm which of these works for your team (all times PST):
- Thu Dec 16 — 10:00 AM
- Fri Dec 17 — 11:00 AM (preferred on my side)
- Fri Dec 17 — 04:00 PM

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf (overview) and mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft timeline & owner RACI).

If it helps, I can loop in our security lead and solutions engineer to the session — please let me know the right contacts on your side to include (security, procurement, and your tech architect).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0187
